headline: Rebranding the Rose Baker Center, building security upgrades, and transportation and health program updates.
summary: The meeting covers rebranding of the Rose Baker Center, updates from the Gloucester Health Department, YMCA at Gloucester Crossing, and Cape Ann Transportation Authority. It also covers program development, building and grounds projects, DPW projects, and IT security projects.
